purpose: Exploratory fixed Ridge versus Random Forest versus Gradient Boosting comparison on unchanged retrospective yield cohorts
exposure: Ridge results on all five seasons were inspected before this extension. Tree settings are fixed before tree fitting. These folds are development evidence, not a fresh final test.
preprocessing: Reuse fold-fitted StandardScaler for Ridge only. Trees consume the same raw numeric features without scaling or imputation. No new features or target transforms.
selection: No parameter search, early stopping, seed selection, clipping or changes after scores are seen. Mean baseline and exact Ridge replay retained. Report all declared configurations.
primary_comparison: main cohort, water_weather inputs: unweighted mean of five held-out-season MAEs; pair each tree model against Ridge on identical observations
secondary: All feature-family/cohort comparisons, pooled MAE/RMSE/bias, season and management errors, negative predictions, descriptive paired season changes
uncertainty: Five folds share training seasons; do not treat folds or plot rows as independent replicates for confidence intervals. No significance or farmer accuracy threshold.
scope: Absolute following-wheat-yield component only. Matched cover-minus-fallow prediction remains the next separate experiment. No changes to API payloads, serving selection, original protocols or prepared data.
